findings.title: CVE-2099-0001: Mock nginx old-version finding
findings.evidence: Offline mock DB matched nginx 1.18.0 on 192.168.56.10:80/tcp using range match.
findings.remediation: Upgrade nginx to a supported release after compatibility testing.

findings.title: CVE-2021-41773: Apache HTTP Server path traversal
findings.evidence: Offline mock DB matched Apache httpd 2.4.49 on 192.168.56.10:8080/tcp using exact match.
findings.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to a supported patched release.
